findings.title: UntrustedData.MaximumObjectGraphDepth raised 500 -> 5000, unrelated to #2234, weakens DoS guard
findings.claim: The depth-limit change has nothing to do with analyzer diagnostics for #2234. It raises the untrusted deserialization depth from 500 to 5000 while the property documentation describes 500 as a conservative value to defend against stack-overflow attacks on untrusted input. This is a security-relevant default change with no accompanying test or rationale.

evidence.quote: Since stack space occupied may vary by the kind of object deserialized, a conservative value for this property to defend against stack overflow attacks might be 500.

findings.suggested_fix: Revert MaximumObjectGraphDepth to 500 for UntrustedData, or have the security/area owner approve 5000 with a documented rationale and a deserialization test.
